name: Gridline SolarBlock Courier Visor
description: Wraparound visor in matte black recycled polycarbonate with UPF-80 tinted shield, sized to clear standard BCI temple arrays without pressure. Adjustable neoprene strap sits over the head without touching neural port rows at the crown. Sweat-drain grooves channel moisture away from eyes during long outdoor runs.
functionality: UPF-80 UV eye and face shield, BCI-port-clearance fit, sweat-drain strap design.
what_it_says: You're outside all day and you've engineered every discomfort out of it.
story_hooks: The tint on one lens is slightly darker — replaced after something cracked the original.
A small scratch on the inner shield, right at eye level, creates a ghost line across your vision at certain sun angles.

physical_description.visual_profile: Sleek wraparound visor that dominates the upper face, extending from temple to temple with a slight downward curve. Minimalist neo-noir urban aesthetic—purely functional with zero decorative elements. Sits proud on the face without touching augmented BCI hardware, giving the wearer an uncluttered, streamlined appearance.
physical_description.fit: Precision-engineered to clear standard temple arrays; adjustable neoprene strap distributes weight evenly across the occipital region, avoiding neural port clusters. Sits just above the brow line with minimal pressure points.
physical_description.primary_material: Matte black recycled polycarbonate; UPF-80 tinted shield (dark amber-gray lens)
physical_description.texture: Smooth, slightly grainy matte finish on the polycarbonate body; subtle grooved channels visible on the inner surface for sweat management; neoprene strap has light ribbed texture for grip
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte black frame with dark amber-tinted shield; minimal contrast, pure stealth aesthetic
physical_description.closures: Adjustable neoprene strap with friction-fit tension (no visible buckles or snaps)
distinctive_features: Sweat-drain grooves etched into inner lens surface
Temple cutouts designed to clear BCI antenna arrays
Crown-safe neoprene design avoids neural port pressure
Gridline logo subtly embossed on left temple
UPF-80 rating stamped on inner strap
Anti-glare coating visible as faint blue-shift on lens surface
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 working class; affordable functional tech for delivery and field operators
physical_description.cultural_context: Courier culture, delivery runners, field logistics, outdoor data-mules. Worn by people who move through the GLMZ in daylight, augmented but not chrome-heavy, practical and purpose-built. No status play—pure utility.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in but maintained; subtle scuff marks from regular use, but frame integrity preserved. Lens may show light dust or sweat residue from active courier runs.
